comparison.objective: Replace a worn soft gripper finger, restore its plate, and place three screws; the candidate adjusts an assembled gripper's opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Part identification, removal, replacement, plate handling, and small-part insertion versus driver/wrench counterholding on a coupled screw and jam nut.
comparison.success_condition: Requires the worn finger binned, new finger seated, plate placed, and three screws inserted; candidate requires a locked 90° setting and retained motion over three cycles.
comparison.reason: Both service robot grippers, but industrial labels and component proximity do not erase the different tested abilities: replacement assembly versus torque-sensitive calibration and locking.
